text:
nina: FYI urgent advisory from AuthSDK team. They disclosed a session fixation issue in auth-sdk-java that can allow reuse of session cookies in certain refresh flows. Affects versions 3.0.0 -> 3.0.5. Patch: 3.0.6. :rotating_light:

kevin: Which services use the vulnerable library?

auth-bot: Detected usages: web-sso, admin-console, infra-portal, onboarding-service (see inventory link).

nina: Immediate plan: 1) upgrade auth-sdk-java to 3.0.6 in affected services; 2) rotate long-lived service sessions and API keys used by those services; 3) tighten session TTL for web-sso to 1h for the next 48h; 4) enable `reject_stale_refresh=true` config in new SDK.

sre-maya: I'll schedule rolling upgrades for web-sso and admin-console tonight. Canary to staging first, then prod in 8h if no anomalies.

sam: Devs: update `pom.xml` or gradle lockfile to `com.redwood:auth-sdk:3.0.6` and add an integration test that asserts refresh tokens result in new session ids.

kevin: Detection probe (run against staging web-sso):
```
# simulate refresh and check session id change
curl -i -c cookies.txt -X POST https://staging-web-sso.redwood.ai/login -d 'user=test&pass=test'
# call refresh endpoint
curl -i -b cookies.txt -c newcookies.txt -X POST https://staging-web-sso.redwood.ai/refresh
# compare session ids in cookies
```
Look for identical session ids after refresh -> FAIL. If fail, rollback and escalate.

compliance-rita: Please record all rotated keys and include who approved rotation in the audit log. We also need screenshots of the new TTL setting in Console.

sre-maya: Canary deployed to staging +20m. No auth regressions so far. I'm enabling `reject_stale_refresh=true` in canary env.

nina: Also, remove legacy service principals that still have admin-console write scope. Run the audit script: `./tools/iam-audit --filter "admin-console" --older-than 90d` and revoke as needed.

sam: If teams can't meet the 24h window, fallback: disable refresh endpoint on the service via feature flag `auth.disable_refresh=true` (causes re-login required).

kevin: Created ticket SEC-2026-202 in Jira and assigned to @sre-maya and @sam. Tag PRs with that ticket.

compliance-rita: Once complete, email compliance@redwood with: list of upgraded services, rotated keys, TTL screenshots, and Jira ticket link.

nina: Thanks everyone. Post final closure message in this thread when done. :thumbsup:
